launch_evidence.quote: Empliciti was launched in the U.S. in December 2015.

series_end_reason: The fourth-quarter 2022 release (2023-02-02) is the last to print an Empliciti row. The first-quarter 2023 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/14272/000001427223000102/q12023ex991.htm) and every later release through 2026Q3 have no Empliciti row; the 2023Q1 table folds such brands into 'Mature and other products (a)' ('(a) Includes over-the-counter (OTC) products, royalty revenue and mature products'), and the first-quarter 2024 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/14272/000001427224000094/q12024ex991-filing.htm) names it: '(a) Includes Nulojix, Onureg, Inrebic, Empliciti and royalty revenue'.
search_log: Listed every filing (all forms) for CIK 0000014272 (Bristol-Myers Squibb) via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. the older 'files' pages; selected every 8-K/8-K/A whose items include 2.02 (105 filings, 2004-10-29 to 2026-10-29) and fetched every document in each filing's index.json except the cover document and R*.htm pages; product rows read from Exhibit 99.1 (the file name matching 'ex99.?1' or 'ex991'), whose first product table is the quarter table.

Row rule: first table row of the Exhibit 99.1 whose first cell begins with the product name and whose first figure cell is a number. 2015Q4-2022Q4 releases print worldwide quarter then same quarter a year earlier (2019Q4-2022Q4 also a summary table on the first page, which is the row read); from the 2023Q1 release the columns are U.S., Int'l, WW and the WW (third) figure is used.
Empliciti product row present in every BMS Exhibit 99.1 from 2015Q4 to 2022Q4, absent from 2023Q1 on.

Full-year checks (quarters against the twelve-month figure of the Q4 release): 2016: quarters sum to 150; twelve-month figure 150 (current column of the 2016Q4 release); 2017: quarters sum to 231; twelve-month figure 231 (current column of the 2017Q4 release); 2018: quarters sum to 247; twelve-month figure 247 (current column of the 2018Q4 release); 2019: quarters sum to 357; twelve-month figure 357 (current column of the 2019Q4 release); 2020: quarters sum to 381; twelve-month figure 381 (current column of the 2020Q4 release); 2021: quarters sum to 334; twelve-month figure 334 (current column of the 2021Q4 release); 2022: quarters sum to 296; twelve-month figure 296 (current column of the 2022Q4 release)
